info.en:
These maps were created using data from the 2024 Moldovan census, available at https://statistica.gov.md/ro/statistic_indicator_details/60.
The names of the religious denominations were taken from https://www.asp.gov.md/sites/default/files/date-deschise/lista-beneficiarilor-desemnarii-procentuale/Lista-religioase-2025.pdf and https://infobiz.md/en/1017620002171/cultul-religios-uniunea-bisericilor-crestine-evanghelice-baptiste-din-moldova.
Transnistria was not covered by the census. Its data (unofficial) comes from the 2015 census of the self-proclaimed Pridnestrovian Moldavian Republic, available at https://web.archive.org/web/20180814231257/http://privetpmr.ru/perepis-naseleniya-pmr.

unofficial.en: Unofficial data. Transnistria was not covered by the Moldovan census; these figures come from the 2015 census of the self-proclaimed Pridnestrovian Moldavian Republic (PMR), as reported in the press, and are not official statistics. The ethnic shares add up to more than 100% (86.2% declared plus about 14% not stated). Rîbnița, Grigoriopol and Dubăsari are only given in rounded thousands, Romanians and Roma were not recorded separately, and there is no religion data.
